label: Every NECESSARY_2 actual concretum is an actual root of the selected grounding relation
paraphrase: OPEN (NAR, analyst formulation, unattributed): every concrete being that exists at w and at every world accessible from w (NECESSARY_2, NecessaryAt) has no actual concrete ground at w in the selected grounding relation, i.e. is an actual root. The denial of 'necessary through another' for modal necessity; it is not about the tertia via's NECESSARY_3/NECESSARY_4 (a being necessary in that sense may have its necessity from another). With excluded middle it is equivalent to: whatever has an actual concrete ground at w is not NECESSARY_2 at w. Its rival is a necessary being necessarily emanated from another (Avicenna's necessary through another; note section 4).
